# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_doc.py from the types in src/ and src/config_compat.tov. Do not edit by hand: run `make config-doc`. -->

Every key of `config.json` that Raiju reads. The file format is Bifrost's, so a Bifrost config loads as it is;
Bifrost names that Raiju maps on load are listed at the end. Values written `env.NAME` are read from the
environment when the config loads. `<name>` stands for a key you choose (a provider's name, a map key), and `[]`
for each element of a list. Descriptions are the comments in the source; defaults are given there when a key
has one. The command-line flags (`-app-dir`, `-config`, `-host`, `-port`, `-workers`, `-server`, `-mode`,
`-healthcheck`) are in the README.

1365 keys (564 with a description), and 38 Bifrost keys read through config_compat.

## Sections

- [`encryption_key`](#encryption_key): Bifrost's encryption_key: saved provider key values are encrypted with it (env.NAME allowed)
- [`setup_token`](#setup_token): Bifrost's setup_token: the operator's secret for the first admin account (env.NAME allowed); while no admin exists, POST /api/users needs it in the X-Bifrost-Setup-Token header
- [`client`](#client): Gateway-wide request handling: logging, auth on inference, CORS, body limits, header handling and MCP defaults (Bifrost's client section).
- [`providers`](#providers): Providers by name (openai, anthropic, a custom name, ...): their keys, network settings and quirks.
- [`governance`](#governance): Virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, teams, customers, users, roles, routing rules and admin auth.
- [`cache`](#cache): The exact-match response cache.
- [`pricing`](#pricing): Price overrides by model, on top of the built-in table and pricing sync.
- [`prompt_cache`](#prompt_cache): The gateway's prompt-cache breakpoints (Anthropic-style cache_control).
- [`health`](#health): Provider health checks and the key and provider cool-down after failures.
- [`circuit_breaker_policies`](#circuit_breaker_policies): circuit breaker policies: a primary's circuit opens on response headers and reroutes to a fallback
- [`guardrails`](#guardrails): PII and secret redaction and the other guardrails, on requests and answers.
- [`logs_store`](#logs_store): The request log store (files under the app dir; /api/logs reads it).
- [`otel`](#otel): OpenTelemetry traces and metrics export (OTLP over HTTP or gRPC).
- [`telemetry`](#telemetry): Bifrost's telemetry plugin config (push_gateway; mapped from plugins[telemetry] by config_compat)
- [`mcp`](#mcp): The MCP gateway: client connections, tool execution, tool groups and code mode.
- [`plugins`](#plugins): Plugins in Bifrost's format: built-in names, WebAssembly files or URLs, with their config.
- [`semantic_cache`](#semantic_cache): The semantic cache: embedding model, threshold and where entries are kept.
- [`vector_store`](#vector_store): Where semantic cache entries go when not in memory (Bifrost's top-level vector_store)
- [`pricing_sync`](#pricing_sync): Periodic download of the pricing datasheet.
- [`auth_config`](#auth_config): Bifrost's deprecated top-level auth_config; governance.auth_config wins
- [`secrets`](#secrets): Secret references resolved when the config loads (env, files, cloud secret managers).
- [`audit`](#audit): The tamper-evident audit log of management actions.
- [`alerts`](#alerts): Alert rules and the channels they notify.
- [`session_affinity`](#session_affinity): Sticky routing of a session to one key or provider.
- [`complexity_router`](#complexity_router): Routing by prompt complexity tiers.
- [`mcp_server`](#mcp_server): Raiju's own MCP server at /mcp, which serves the gateway's tools to MCP clients.
- [`virtual_mcps`](#virtual_mcps): named tool sets from several MCP servers, served at /mcp/{name}
- [`log_exports`](#log_exports): Periodic export of request logs to object storage.
- [`exporters`](#exporters): Streaming log exporters (Kafka, HTTP sinks, ...).
- [`cluster`](#cluster): Several Raiju nodes sharing usage, state and configuration (docs/operations.md when present).
- [`oidc`](#oidc): Sign-in to the web UI and API with an OpenID Connect provider.
- [`auth_proxy`](#auth_proxy): identity-aware proxy in front of the API (Bifrost's authProxy under scim_config)
- [`scim_config`](#scim_config): inbound SCIM 2.0 provisioning at /scim/v2 (scim.tov)
- [`proxy_config`](#proxy_config): The global outbound proxy (Bifrost's top-level proxy_config, GET/PUT /api/proxy-config). A provider without its own proxy_config uses it when enabled and enable_for_inference is set.
- [`prompt_repo`](#prompt_repo): Bifrost-style prompt repository (prompts.tov): prompts with their versions, and deployments
- [`metadata`](#metadata): Bifrost's POST /api/config/metadata: UI and admin preferences (string, number or bool values)
- [`webhooks`](#webhooks): Bifrost's webhooks: endpoints that get signed async-job outcomes (webhooks.tov)
- [`agents`](#agents): Bifrost's agents: registered A2A agents, served at /agents/a2a/{name} (agents.tov)
- [`server`](#server): Bifrost's server section; Raiju reads a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks (push callbacks may be private addresses), the A2A gRPC keys, plugin_download_private_allowlist and its own lifecycle keys (graceful stop, timeouts, connection cap)
- [`feature_flags`](#feature_flags): Bifrost's feature_flags: boot-time overrides of the flags in flags.tov
- [`user_agent_mappings`](#user_agent_mappings): User-Agent to app mappings for the request logs (logapi.tov); edited through /api/logs/user-agent-mappings
- [`websocket`](#websocket): Bifrost's websocket section: the session cap per WebSocket route (see WebSocketConfig)
- [`large_payload_optimization`](#large_payload_optimization): Bifrost's large_payload_optimization: big request bodies stream to the provider (see LargePayloadConfig)
- [`crews`](#crews): Raiju-only crew routing (crew.tov, docs/crew-routing.md): pools whose model is crew/<pool>

## client

Gateway-wide request handling: logging, auth on inference, CORS, body limits, header handling and MCP defaults (Bifrost's client section).

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client` | object | Gateway-wide request handling: logging, auth on inference, CORS, body limits, header handling and MCP defaults (Bifrost's client section). |
| `client.drop_excess_requests` | bool | a provider whose queue (concurrency_and_buffer_size, or Bifrost's default 1000 + 5000) is full sheds requests |
| `client.vk_rotation_cooldown` | string | how long a rotated virtual key's old value keeps working, as a duration ("0" or unset: at once) |
| `client.extra_fields_placement` | string | "body" (default) or "headers": where Bifrost's extra_fields (raw request/response) go |
| `client.disable_content_logging` | bool | Bifrost's content-logging controls: keep request and response bodies out of the log store and exporters; the x-bf-disable-content-logging header counts only when allow_per_request_content_storage_override is on |
| `client.allow_per_request_content_storage_override` | bool |  |
| `client.retain_content_in_object_storage` | bool | keep the bodies of a content-off request in logs_store.object_storage, as hidden objects (retained.tov) |
| `client.enable_logging` | bool | one JSON line per request on stdout (default true) |
| `client.enable_governance` | bool | read and kept for Bifrost files; Raiju does not switch governance with it |
| `client.enforce_governance_header` | bool | Bifrost's older name for enforce_auth_on_inference |
| `client.enforce_auth_on_inference` | bool | Bifrost: require a virtual key (or admin credentials) on inference. When omitted it is on if the config has any credentials to use (virtual keys, admin users or auth_config). |
| `client.required_headers` | string[] | headers every inference request must carry (lower-case names), e.g. ["x-team"] |
| `client.allow_direct_keys` | bool | callers may send their own provider key (x-bf-direct-key: true + Authorization / x-api-key) |
| `client.refuse_unpriced_models` | bool | Raiju only: refuse a request that is subject to a budget when its model has no price (no datasheet row, override or config price). Off, the request passes and its cost is 0, as in Bifrost. |
| `client.allow_per_request_raw_override` | bool | x-bf-send-back-raw-request / -response headers override the provider's send_back_raw_* settings |
| `client.allowed_origins` | string[] | browser origins that get CORS headers ("*" for any); empty: no CORS headers |
| `client.max_request_body_size_mb` | int | larger request bodies are refused with 413 (default 100) |
| `client.prometheus_labels` | string[] | extra label names on the bifrost_* request metrics, filled from request headers |
| `client.async_job_result_ttl` | int | seconds |
| `client.mcp_agent_depth` | int | MCP agent mode: how many rounds of tool execution a request may run (default 10) |
| `client.mcp_auto_execute` | string[] | MCP agent mode: tool calls to these chat tool names ("<server>-<tool>", or "*") run in the gateway |
| `client.mcp_disable_auto_tool_inject` | bool | Bifrost: MCP tools are not added to chat requests unless a request names its clients (x-bf-mcp-include-clients) |
| `client.a2a_external_client_url` | string | Bifrost's a2a_external_client_url: the public base URL the A2A gateway's agent cards advertise (agents.tov) |
| `client.a2a_card_refresh_seconds` | int | Raiju's: how often the cards of the registered agents are fetched again, in seconds (default 300; 0 turns the timer off). A card is also fetched again, at most once a minute, when the agent answers HTTP 404, 405, 410 or 426. |
| `client.a2a_store_raw_request_response` | bool | Bifrost's a2a_store_raw_request_response: each A2A call's log row keeps the bytes sent to the agent and the bytes it answered (base64, at most 1 MiB each way), shown by GET /api/agents/history/{id} (ops.tov a2aCall) |
| `client.logging_headers` | string[] | request headers copied into each log row's metadata: exact names, or prefixes ending in "*" (reqlog.tov) |
| `client.compat` | object | Bifrost's compat plugin settings (src/compat.tov); absent means the plugin is off unless a request's x-bf-compat turns features on |
| `client.compat.convert_text_to_chat` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.convert_chat_to_responses` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.should_drop_params` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.should_convert_params` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.azure_deepseek` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.force_reasoning_only_models_to_responses` | bool |  |
| `client.compat.convert_decision_to_responses` | bool | A section that is there turns every feature on, except convert_decision_to_responses. |
| `client.header_filter_config` | object | Bifrost's header controls. header_filter_config filters the x-bf-eh-* headers sent upstream (an allowlist, when set, is the only way in; the denylist always blocks). allowed_headers adds to the CORS allow list. whitelisted_routes skip the admin login (exact paths). |
| `client.header_filter_config.allowlist` | string[] | header_filter_config filters the x-bf-eh-* headers sent upstream (an allowlist, when set, is the only way in; the denylist always blocks). |
| `client.header_filter_config.denylist` | string[] | header_filter_config filters the x-bf-eh-* headers sent upstream (an allowlist, when set, is the only way in; the denylist always blocks). |
| `client.allowed_headers` | string[] |  |
| `client.whitelisted_routes` | string[] |  |
| `client.dual_credential_conflict_behavior` | string | Bifrost: an inference request with both an identity token and x-bf-vk: "error" (400), "prefer_vk" (the token is dropped) or "prefer_idp" (default). Raiju's identity is OIDC (oidc.tov). |
| `client.dump_errors_in_console_logs` | bool | Bifrost: full error details go to the server console (never to the client) |
| `client.routing_chain_max_depth` | int | Bifrost: the deepest model alias chain a key may follow (default 10) |
| `client.hidden_request_types` | string[] | Bifrost: request types left out of the log and dashboard reads (logs are still stored) |
| `client.hide_deleted_virtual_keys_in_filters` | bool | Bifrost's virtual key lifecycle settings (read and kept; vk_rotation_cooldown is above) Not applied: hide_deleted_virtual_keys_in_filters has no effect: Raiju deletes a virtual key outright, so no deleted keys appear in the filters. |
| `client.delete_expired_virtual_keys` | bool |  |
| `client.enforce_vk_object_ownership` | bool |  |
| `client.mcp_enable_temp_token_auth` | bool | Bifrost: scoped temp tokens may open the per-user MCP consent flows (src/mcpuser.tov) |
| `client.mcp_server_auth_mode` | string | Bifrost's MCP server auth for /mcp: "headers" (default; virtual keys only), "both" (keys and Bifrost-issued JWTs) or "oauth" (JWTs only). Raiju is the authorization server (src/mcpissuer.tov). |
| `client.oauth2_server_config` | object | Bifrost's oauth2_server_config. issuer_url is the authorization server's identity (the iss claim and the discovery documents) and is required when client.mcp_server_auth_mode is "both" or "oauth". signing_key is the RS256 private key (PEM, PKCS#1 or PKCS#8) that signs the tokens. When it is not set, Raiju generates one at the first start and keeps it in mcp-oauth-state.json beside config.json (as Bifrost stores its own), and a configured key always wins. issuer_url and signing_key may be env.NAME references. |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.issuer_url` | string | issuer_url is the authorization server's identity (the iss claim and the discovery documents) and is required when client.mcp_server_auth_mode is "both" or "oauth". issuer_url and signing_key may be env.NAME references. |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.auth_code_ttl` | int |  |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.access_token_ttl` | int |  |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.allowed_redirect_uris` | string[] |  |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.disable_vk_identity` | bool |  |
| `client.oauth2_server_config.signing_key` | string | signing_key is the RS256 private key (PEM, PKCS#1 or PKCS#8) that signs the tokens. issuer_url and signing_key may be env.NAME references. |
| `client.webhook_config` | object | Bifrost's webhook settings: deliveries older than this many days are dropped (default 30) |
| `client.webhook_config.delivery_history_retention_days` | int |  |

## governance

|---|---|---|
| `governance` | object | Virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, teams, customers, users, roles, routing rules and admin auth. |
| `governance.auth_config` | object | Credentials for the management API and UI (Bifrost's governance.auth_config, or its deprecated top-level auth_config): admin_username/admin_password/is_enabled as Bifrost writes them, or username/password/token. |

| Key | Type | Description |

Bifrost's logs_store.object_storage: the hybrid store's bucket (each row's payload fields go there, hybrid.tov) and where retained content goes (client.retain_content_in_object_storage) |

| `logs_store.object_storage.compress` | bool | gzip each object (keys end in .json.gz); the legacy form of compression "gzip" |
| `logs_store.object_storage.format` | string | the hybrid store's object format, "json" (default) or "parquet" (a one-row file, keys end in .parquet), and its compression: none or gzip for json; none, gzip, snappy or zstd for parquet (snappy and zstd are written as GZIP pages) |

Its "config" object can hold any JSON, which typed parsing can't, so it's kept as raw text in config_json. placement and order are Bifrost's sequencing fields: the placement group (pre_builtin, builtin or post_builtin, default post_builtin) and the position within it (lower runs first, default 0). path names a .wasm file (Bifrost's custom plugin path; only WebAssembly plugins load, see wasmplugin.tov) and wasm_limits caps that plugin: pages of memory, bytes of operand stack, instructions per hook call. sha256 (Raiju) pins the plugin file: the file (or the copy of a URL) must have this SHA-256 to load, and a URL may be plain http only when it is pinned (plugindl.tov). |

## server

Bifrost's server section; Raiju reads a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks (push callbacks may be private addresses), the A2A gRPC keys, plugin_download_private_allowlist and its own lifecycle keys (graceful stop, timeouts, connection cap)

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | object | Bifrost's server section; Raiju reads a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks (push callbacks may be private addresses), the A2A gRPC keys, plugin_download_private_allowlist and its own lifecycle keys (graceful stop, timeouts, connection cap) |
| `server.a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks` | bool | Raiju reads a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks (push callbacks may be private addresses), the A2A gRPC keys, plugin_download_private_allowlist and its own lifecycle keys (graceful stop, timeouts, connection cap) |
| `server.a2a_grpc_base_domain` | string | a2a_grpc_base_domain and a2a_grpc_port enable the A2A gRPC binding (a2agrpc.tov): agents are served at <name>.<base domain>, the port is the advertised one (RAIJU_A2A_GRPC_LISTEN_PORT overrides the bind port). |
| `server.a2a_grpc_port` | int | a2a_grpc_base_domain and a2a_grpc_port enable the A2A gRPC binding (a2agrpc.tov): agents are served at <name>.<base domain>, the port is the advertised one (RAIJU_A2A_GRPC_LISTEN_PORT overrides the bind port). |
| `server.plugin_download_private_allowlist` | string[] | plugin_download_private_allowlist: hosts a plugin URL may name although they are private (plugindl.tov), as Bifrost reads it. Raiju reads a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks (push callbacks may be private addresses), the A2A gRPC keys, plugin_download_private_allowlist and its own lifecycle keys (graceful stop, timeouts, connection cap) |
| `server.shutdown_grace_seconds` | number | after SIGTERM, how long the requests in hand may take (default 25) |
| `server.shutdown_delay_seconds` | number | after SIGTERM, how long the listener keeps accepting while /ready answers 503 (default 0) |
| `server.header_timeout_seconds` | number | a request head must arrive within this (default 10; 0 off) |
| `server.idle_timeout_seconds` | number | a keep-alive connection with no request closes after this (default 60; 0 off) |
| `server.body_timeout_seconds` | number | a request body may go this long without a byte (default 60; 0 off) |
| `server.max_connections` | int | open connections per process (default three quarters of ulimit -n; -1 no cap) |
| `server.webrtc_enabled` | bool | webrtc_enabled (Raiju's; Bifrost has no switch) turns on the WebRTC realtime and live calls the gateway terminates on its own peer (POST /v1/realtime/calls, POST /v1/realtime, POST /v1/live/sessions). |
| `server.metrics_token` | string | Raiju's: when set (env.NAME allowed), /metrics answers only a request with "Authorization: Bearer <token>" (401 otherwise). Unset keeps Bifrost's open /metrics. |
| `server.trusted_proxies` | string[] | Raiju's own (Bifrost believes no forwarding header): the addresses or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies in front of the gateway. Only a request from one of them has its X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP taken as the client's address (clientip.tov), for the audit log and the sign-in throttle. Empty (the default): the TCP peer is the client. |
| `server.sign_in_throttle` | object | Raiju's sign-in throttle (signinguard.tov): past the free failures within an hour, each attempt waits twice as long as the last (1 s, 2 s, 4 s, ...), answered 429 with Retry-After and not checked. On by default. |
| `server.sign_in_throttle.enabled` | bool | false turns the throttle off (default true) |
| `server.sign_in_throttle.account_failures` | int | free failed sign-ins per account name within an hour (default 5) |
| `server.sign_in_throttle.ip_failures` | int | free failed sign-ins per client address within an hour (default 20) |
| `server.sign_in_throttle.max_backoff_seconds` | int | the longest wait (default 900) |

## Bifrost keys read through config_compat

These are Bifrost names that `src/config_compat.tov` reads: most are rewritten on load to the Raiju key
that holds the same setting (for example `cluster_config` to `cluster`, `alerting` to `alerts`), and the
ones with a note are read and not applied. The startup log says what each file's keys became.

| Key | Note |
|---|---|
| `access_profiles` | Read as `governance.access_profiles`. |
| `alerting` | Read as `alerts`. |
| `audit_logs` | Read as `audit`. |
| `circuit_breaker_config` | Read as `circuit_breaker_policies`. |
| `client.disable_db_pings_in_health` | Is not used: Raiju has no database. |
| `client.enforce_scim_auth` | Is accepted and ignored: Bifrost's deprecated mirror of enforce_auth_on_inference, which it overwrites on load; set client.enforce_auth_on_inference. |
| `client.initial_pool_size` | Is a Go connection-pool setting that Raiju does not use. |
| `client.log_retention_days` | Read as `logs_store.retention_days`. |
| `client.mcp_code_mode_binding_level` | Read as `mcp.code_mode_binding_level`. |
| `client.mcp_code_mode_limits` | Read as `mcp.code_mode_limits`. |
| `client.mcp_external_client_url` | Is not implemented by Raiju and is ignored. |
| `client.mcp_tool_execution_timeout` | Read as `mcp.tool_execution_timeout_seconds`. |
| `client.mcp_tool_sync_interval` | Read as `mcp.tool_sync_interval`. |
| `client.skills_external_client_url` | Is not implemented by Raiju and is ignored. |
| `cluster_config` | Read as `cluster`. |
| `cluster_config.broker.auth_token` | Read as `cluster.secret`. |
| `config_store` | Is not used: Raiju saves its config to the file given by -config. |
| `env_label` | Accepted (Bifrost's environment label); no effect. |
| `framework` | `framework.pricing` is read as `pricing_sync`. |
| `framework.pricing` | Read as `pricing_sync`. |
| `governance.complexity_analyzer_config` | Bifrost's complexity analyzer, read into `complexity_router`. |
| `guardrails_config` | Bifrost's guardrails, translated into `guardrails` when the config loads and merged with it (never saved back). |
| `load_balancer_config` | Read as `health.adaptive`. |
| `mcp.tool_groups` | Read as `virtual_mcps`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config` | Bifrost's MCP runtime settings: each one is moved to the Raiju key named in its row when that key is unset (the Raiju key wins). |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.code_mode_binding_level` | Read as `mcp.code_mode_binding_level`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.code_mode_limits` | Read as `mcp.code_mode_limits`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.disable_auto_tool_inject` | Read as `client.mcp_disable_auto_tool_inject`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.max_agent_depth` | Read as `client.mcp_agent_depth`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.max_instructions_per_client` | Read as `mcp.max_instructions_per_client`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.max_instructions_total` | Read as `mcp.max_instructions_total`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.oauth_private_allowlist` | Read as `mcp.oauth_private_allowlist`. |
| `mcp.tool_manager_config.tool_execution_timeout` | Read as `mcp.tool_execution_timeout_seconds`. |
| `mcp.virtual_mcps` | Read as `virtual_mcps`. |
| `server.read_buffer_size` | Accepted; no Raiju counterpart (the command line takes -host and -port). |
| `skills_registry` | Is not implemented by Raiju and is ignored. |
| `source_of_truth` | Accepted (Bifrost's config-store setting); no effect: Raiju's source of truth is the file. |
| `version` | Accepted (Bifrost's file version); no effect. |
